book.name: LUKE
book.title: Id ash d Luke Oꞌohana ab Amjed g Jiosh Alidag

content: Hegam uꞌuwi mash an wehmaj g Jesus
Sh amjed am hu hebai, tsh g Jesus am hih ha oidk g kihhim k am ahgahim g s‑kehg haꞌichu ahga ab amjed g Jiosh kownaltalig. Kush hegam gamai gohk chuhchaij am wehmaj.
Kutsh muꞌi am ha oi g uꞌuwi. Idam atsh wa ha dodaj g Jesus. Kush am haꞌichukaj i ha wehmt. Hema idam ash d Mary Magdalene. Id atsh g Jesus ab amjed i ha wuwhas g wewaꞌak jijawul.
Kush hema d Joanna. Sh g wehmaj kihkam ihda hab chehgig Chusa ch d haꞌichu am kownal wecho. Kush hema ehp d Susanna. Tsh idam uꞌuwi wo em‑nolawt hegai mash haschu i tatchua hegam Jesus.
Haꞌichu wepogida ahga ab amjed g haꞌichu eshdam
Kutsh muꞌi hemajkam ab hihi Jesus wui ga hu aꞌai kihhim amjed. Tsh am ha ahgi g Jesus ihda wepogida ahga:
“Nt wo haꞌichu em‑mashcha ab amjed g Jiosh kownaltalig wepogidch mat hema an ei g haꞌichu e‑kaichka e‑oidag ed. T haꞌi gan hu wabsh shul wohg ch ed. T g hemajkam am keish k g uꞌuwhig am huh.
T haꞌi gan hu shul mo pi geꞌej g jewed ab waw t ab. T ab i chum wuhsh g eꞌes k wabsh gaksh no pi pi wadag amai.
T haꞌi gan hu shul g kaichkaj shaꞌi ch ed. T heg am wabsh wehnadk i geꞌege k ha kokda g esha.
T wabshaba hegam mat an s‑ap shul moihuna ch ed an wuhshani k siant ab kait hehemako.” Sh hab hahawa ep kaij g Jesus, “Neh, am g wo i aꞌamichud ahpim mam kah ihda.”
Mash haschu ahgch g Jesus g wepogida ahgakaj ha mashcham
Kush g Jesus chuhchai ab kakke mas has d ahga ihda wepogida ahga.

Sh hab kaij g Jesus, “Nt wo em‑ahgi mo has d ahga no pi g Jiosh em‑hiwgid mamt wo s‑mai hegai mo haschu hemu am maskogid ab amjed g e‑kownaltalig. Ni wabshaba heg waꞌi ha ahgid haꞌichu wepogida ahga hegam mo pi ab hu wohochudamk. T hab pi wo amich haꞌichu ab amjed g Jiosh kownaltalig, chum as wo haꞌichu neid k wo haꞌichu kah.”
Mash g Jiosh haꞌichu ahgdam hab masma mo g haꞌichu eshdam
Kush hab ep kaij g Jesus, “Neh, nt wo em‑tashogi ihda haꞌichu wepogida ni‑ahga. Jiosh haꞌichu ahga o wepogidas mo g haꞌichu kai ch am wo e gantad hemajkam ha‑iꞌibdag ed.
K eda haꞌi g ha‑iꞌibdag s‑kawpk hab masma mo g wohg. K g Jiawul am wabsh s‑pehegi ha wohppoꞌid hegai mo haschu i kah. T hab pi ab hu wo wohoch g Jiosh haꞌichu ahga k pi wo e doꞌibia.

“K haꞌi g ha‑iꞌibdag hab sha masma mo hebai pi geꞌej g jewed ab waw t ab. T idam wo si s‑hohhoꞌi g Jiosh haꞌichu ahga ab kaiok k wabshaba pi wihnam ab hu wo bebhe k ch ab hi wa al heꞌes wo s‑wohochudad. T ab wabsh wo i chum hih g aꞌappema. T ha hekaj wabsh wo taꞌi i shul.
“K haꞌi g ha‑iꞌibdag hab sha masma mo hebai s‑shaꞌig no pi e shaꞌijidch heg hekaj kudutadag ch s‑kaisdag ch s‑tahhadkam. Kut pi haꞌichu hab wo juh am Jiosh wehhejed.
“K haꞌi g ha‑iꞌibdag s‑moik hab masma mo g moihuna. Kut ab wo kaiha g Jiosh haꞌichu ahga k am wo si i nuhkud e‑ihbdag ed k am wo e nako mat am hab haꞌichu wo juh Jiosh wehhejed.
Mamt pi am hu wo ehsto g wohokam
“Wohokam o wepogidas mo g lahmpa tonlig. Namt hig wo ehsto g lahmpa ab mehidk aha namt an wo dai mat hebai wo em‑tonlidch. Pegih, mt hab wa masma pi wo chum ehsto g wohokam.
Wehs at wo s‑e mai matp haschu chum e ehstokch. T haschu wo i chum e maꞌishchid wo e chehg k am wo i e wuhshad.
“Am g wo s‑amichud mam haschu i kah. Hegam mat s‑ap wo hekaj g e‑apꞌedag at baꞌich ep wo i nei. T wabshaba hegam mat pi ap wo hekaj wabsh wo heb hu wua.”
Mash g jeꞌej ch wepngaj s‑neidamk g Jesus
Tsh am chum dada g Jesus jeꞌe ch wepngaj. Sh wabshaba si muꞌij g hemajkam an wehgaj. Kutsh pi e nako matsh ab wo miabi.
Sh hema hab kaij ab wui g Jesus, “M‑jeꞌe ch m‑wepnag o am gegok jeg ed s‑m‑neidamkch.”
Sh hab ahg g Jesus, “Neh, idam mo ab ni‑kaiham ch ab s‑wohog elid g Jiosh haꞌichu ahga o heg wa wepo mo d ni‑jeꞌe ch ni‑wepnag.”
Matsh g Jesus dodolimach g hewel ch shuhdagi toꞌotonk
Sh am hu hebai hab ha ahg g Jesus g e‑chuhchai, “Am att hu hig shuhdagi aigojed wo i chehchsh.” Tsh wa woho am dadhaiwua wahlko ch ed k am gahi i shul.

Sh am hebai him g wahlko shuhdagi ch ed. Tsh g Jesus am i woꞌiwua k koi. Kutsh g hewel ab haha wabsh i meh. Tsh ab i toꞌotonkai g shuhdagi k am iawua wahlko ch ed mash s‑ta ehbidam hab mahs ha wehhejed.

Kutsh g chuhchaij am wui dada g Jesus k am wuhan k hab kaij, “T‑mashchamdam, ttki wo t‑koꞌij.” Tsh am i wami g Jesus k ab si cheha g hewel ch shuhdagi toꞌotonk. Tsh am i wehs haꞌasa k gam hu wabsh i pi shahmuni.

Sh hab hahawa kaij ab ha wui, “Ab g wabsh wo ni‑hiwgad.” Kutsh eda si has i elid k si s‑ehbeni k ash hab kaij ab aꞌai e wui, “Kus hedai wud ihda oꞌodham ch ab si chehani g hewel ch toꞌotonk mat wo haꞌasa. K ab s‑wohog elid.”
Matsh g Jesus gam hu hab i ha juh g jijawul ab amjed g hema cheoj
Tsh am hihim k gam hu dada ga hu aigojed g Galilee shuhdagi heg maibidch kihhim mash d Geresa.
Kush am hema oimmed g cheoj jeg ed ch am chum kih heg eda kihhim. Sh wabshaba g jijawul an uꞌukch g chegitoidaj. Kush gan hu wabsh kih mash an chehchog ch an e hihashp g koꞌi. Kutsh ab i hud g Jesus.

Tsh id am chehg k si s‑kaidam hihnk ch ab i meh pi haꞌichu enigadadch mash hab wa chuꞌig k ab wui i gehsh k si s‑kaidam hab kaij, “Jesus, alidaj g si uhgk Jiosh, gam g hu hihm k pi koꞌokam has ni‑juhni.”

Bash kaij nash pi g Jesus ab si ha chehani g jijawul mat ab wo i wuwha amjed. Kush wa eda g jijawul muꞌikko an bebhe ihda. Kumsh gd hu chum si kukpadch ch g kakhioj ch nohnhoij g e hukshchim wapainomikaj gan hu si wupulshp. Kush wabsh ha wanikumiak g e hukshchim wapainomi. Tsh g jiawul gam hu wo i wushshad tohono jewed ch ed.
Sh hab kaij g Jesus ab wui, “Shahp chehgig?” Sh hab kaij, “Bani chehgig Muꞌichu,” nash pi muꞌi jijawul an uꞌukch.
Tsh g jijawul ab si e shoꞌigch Jesus wui matsh pi am hu wo ha shul Jiawul kih ed.
Sh eda muꞌi an oiopo g kokji kawulk bahsho ch e gegosid. Sh idam jijawul ab si tahni g Jesus matsh am wo ha dagito. Tsh am wo i wahp ha eda idam kokji. Tsh am ha hiwigi g Jesus.
Tsh ab i wuwha ab amjed g oꞌodham k am i wahp ha eda g kokji. Kutsh wehsijj idam kokji am agshp i wohp k gam hu shul shuhdagi ch ed k wachkk.
Tsh hegam mo am ha nuhkud gam hu uhpam wohp k am ahgahim ihda kihhim ch ed ch an ha oidk hegam mo an oꞌoidag.
Tsh g hemajkam am himto mat wo nei mat haschu has e juh. Kush ihda oꞌodham am daha Jesus wui ch ab e enigadadch ch wabsh si s‑ap haꞌichu chegito. Kutsh wabsh wohoꞌi e totods.
Kush hegam mash neid am ha ahgid mat has masma e doaj ihda oꞌodham.
Kush wehsijj idam Geresa t am hemajkam ab ahgid g Jesus mat gam hu wo hih ab ha amjed natsh pi shaꞌi si s‑ehbeni. Tsh wa woho hab e juh k an dahiwua wahlko ch ed mat gam hu wo hih.
Kutsh hegai oꞌodham matsh ab i wuwha g jijawul amjed ab si e shoꞌigch Jesus wui k hab kaij, “Nt wo m‑oi.” K wabshaba g Jesus hab ahg,
“Uhpam g hihm k am wo i ha ahgidahi mat haschu hab juh g Jiosh m‑wehhejed.” Tsh wa woho hab e juh k am i ahgahi kihhim oidk matsh haschu si geꞌe hab juh g Jesus am wehhejed.
Matsh hema uhpam chegitoich g chehia muhki g Jesus
Tsh ga hu aigojed hahawa ep dada hegam Jesus. Kush muꞌi hemajkam am nenida ch si s‑ap i e taht k ab i nei.

Tsh am hema jiwia g oꞌodham k hab chehgig Jairus ch wabsh d haꞌichu am cheopi ch ed. Sh id chehiaga muhkhim ch d gamai gohk aꞌahidag. Kutsh ab wecho si i gei g Jesus k ab ahgid matsh gam hu wo oi kihj wui. Tsh gam hu chum wehmaj hih g Jesus. Tsh g hemajkam am wabsh kawod him k gan hu wabsh i biha.
Kush eda am hema haꞌichug g uwi ch gamai gohk aꞌahidag mumku heg hekaj mo g ehꞌedaj jegwoni. Tsh pi hedai e nako mas wo doaj, chum as wehs hugio g e‑lialiga ha namkidch g mamakai.
Kutsh ab i hih Jesus wehgaj k an taht g kahbaj hugidag. Kutsh am wabsh si haꞌasa g ehꞌed jegwoni.
Sh hab kaij g Jesus, “Doht an ni‑taht.” Tsh pi hedai am hu e ah. Sh hab hahawa kaij g Peter, “T‑mashchamdam, an o m‑bihagch g hemajkam ch ab m‑shodbinch.”
Sh wabshaba hab kaij g Jesus, “Ab at hema ni‑taht. Ni s‑mahch nat pi ab i wuhsh g gewkdag ab ni‑amjed.”
Tsh am i nei hegai uwi mamt s‑mai k ab hahawa i him k si gigiwek ch ab i gei Jesus wecho amai hemajkam ha tahgio k ash am ahgid g Jesus mat haschu ahgk ab taht k has masma ha hekaj doa.
Sh hab kaij g Jesus ab wui, “Pegih, ni‑uwiga, am apt wa doa napt pi ab i ni‑hiw. Gamai g s‑ap e tahtk hihm k am wabsh s‑doakad.”
Kush hab wabsh kia kaij ihda g Jesus. Tsh ab hema mel ab kihj amjed g Jairus k ash hab kaij, “Muh at g m‑chehiaga. Kupt pi am hu ep wo kudu g ha mashchamdam.”
Kutsh kah g Jesus k hab kaij ab wui g Jairus, “Pi g am shaꞌi e todsid. Ab g wabsh i ni‑hiwig. Kut wabsh wo e chegito.”
Kutsh ged hu dada kihj am. Tsh hegam waꞌi ha ui g Jesus Peter ch James ch John ch hegam jehjij g chehia. Tsh am e wehm i wahp.
Kush eda wehsijj shoani ch pi ap e tahtk wehhejed g chehia. Kush hab kaij g Jesus, “Pi g am wo shoanid. Heg o wa wepo ni‑wehhejed mo wabsh kohsh g chehia.”
Kush wabsh has ahg hegam nash pi si s‑mahch mat muh.
Tsh wabshaba g Jesus ab bei nowij ab k ab si neok wui ch hab kaij, “I wamigi, chehia.”
Kutsh uhpam e chegito k ha hekaj i wami. Sh g Jesus am ha chehani mat wo haꞌichu mah. T wo huh.
Tsh hegam jehjij am wabsh e totods matsh e chegito. Sh g Jesus am ha ahgid mat pi hedai wo ha ahgi mat haschu has e juh.
